findings.finding: MASTER_PLAN, BACKLOG, STATUS, and PROJECT_STATE define UASEP as runtime-free and show no active mandatory implementation batch.
C81-C90 documents are documentation artifacts under uasep/c81 through uasep/c90; they do not introduce executable runtime, daemon, scheduler, database, supervisor, or executor code.
The C81-C90 naming can imply an adopted roadmap even though the canonical plan does not define those stages. This is documentation-scope ambiguity, not executable architecture drift.
VERSION remains 3.4.0 and durable project state identifies protocol version 3.4.0.
Repository default branch is main and current connector permissions include push and admin.

decision: Keep C81-C90 as explicitly supplemental documentation unless a concrete requirement adopts them into the normative roadmap. Do not add executable infrastructure.
